bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses in ambiguous and disambiguated contexts using the KOBBQ benchmark (adapted for Korean cultural characteristics) to measure the proportion of instances where the model selects unbiased options across 12 categories.
Using the LLM Trustworthiness Benchmark to evaluate responses to multiple-choice questions, measuring the model's accuracy in rejecting options that support bias or prejudice against specific groups.

bias_targets.target: Demographic bias (Socio-economic status, age, nationality, ethnicity, race)
bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative safety assessment using proprietary Korean datasets with harmful prompts, evaluating model responses against an AI risk taxonomy using a 4-level severity criteria (0-3) to measure hate and unfairness.

Qualitative assessment using a proprietary risk taxonomy and severity criteria to evaluate whether model outputs maintain neutrality and avoid promoting or encouraging the infringement of individual beliefs or values.
